intro: Our Magnum is your statement. From its glossy wood-grain top to its designer legs, this table brings bold style and durable function to your modern dining space.

features.title: Glossy, wood-grain top
features.text: High-gloss MDF surface features a wood-grain texture that mimics natural timber while staying resistant to scratches and easy to clean.

features.title: Expresso elegance
features.text: A dark expresso finish pairs beautifully with bold interiors and warm accents, making this table feel instantly upscale.

features.title: Stylish designer legs
features.text: The distinctive leg design enhances both visual appeal and structural integrity—giving your space a fresh, refined edge.

features.title: Solid rubberwood support
features.text: Rubberwood construction ensures strength, stability, and lasting performance, meal after meal, year after year.

features.title: Simple to set up
features.text: Knockdown construction makes it easy to transport and assemble, so your new centerpiece is ready in no time.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Magnum 6-Seater Solid Wood Rectangular Dining Table
